text-message.area: native: InboxNotifier.kt, the sms: WM box (TextMessageNotifier.kt removed, #1321). No Android notification
text-message.action: Reply | Menu on the box; View opens the conversation
text-message.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Text Messaging 'New text message' (sound, vibrate, display)
text-message.note: N1 data asked for; N4 yes; N6 by conversation id; N7 the WM sms sound once.

inbox-notice.area: native: activesync/InboxNotifier.kt, a server notice with the page asleep: the app's own WM box, the bar's icons and the '...' holder. No Android notification (#1321)
inbox-notice.action: the box's keys (Dismiss | Menu with View and Snooze; a question's answer keys); the holder re-opens it
inbox-notice.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > each notice class (sound, vibrate, display on screen); the source's own notify setting
inbox-notice.note: N1 data asked for or a real alert; N4 yes; N6 by id (page claim, stack coalescing, shown map); N7 the class's WM sound once from the app; N9 newest held box once after the unlock. Locked phone or bars off: no box, sound plus holder.

alarm-ring.area: native: DeviceNotices.kt, the Melaton Mobile alarm ringing with the page asleep
alarm-ring.action: tap opens Melaton Mobile; Dismiss and Snooze 5 minutes buttons; full-screen intent
alarm-ring.switch: the alarm itself (Settings > Clock & Alarms > Alarms: delete or switch it off) and its sound mode (once / repeat / vibrate)
alarm-ring.note: Kept in Android's shade under #1321 (design-decisions.md): only a full-screen-intent notification wakes a locked phone for an alarm she set. Channel silent; the alarm's own chosen sound plays from the app (default is no Alarm file).

battery-low.area: native: DeviceNotices.kt, the bat:low WM box while Melaton Mobile is not in front. No Android notification (#1321); Android's own low battery warning stands
battery-low.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Battery: Main battery low / very low (sound, vibrate, display)
battery-low.note: N1 a real alert; N5 now switched by the two battery events; N7 the event's own WM sound, never Android's default tone.

battery-full.area: native: DeviceNotices.kt, the bat:full WM box. No Android notification (#1321)
battery-full.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Battery: Fully charged (sound off as shipped, display)
battery-full.note: N5 now switched by its event; N7 silent unless she chose a sound.

camera-alert.area: native: CafeTasks.cameraAlert, the cam: WM box for a speed or red light camera ahead. No Android notification (#1321)
camera-alert.switch: the Traffic way-home watch; Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Traffic: Speed camera (sound, vibrate, display)
camera-alert.note: N7 an alert she armed; the same camera is announced once in 20 s (N6). No Android heads-up: on a locked phone only the sound (and the approach strip where it shows).

traffic-watch-fgs.area: native: DriveWatch.kt ongoing() and CafeTasks.kt CafeLocationService, the location foreground service's notification (channel traffic_drive)
traffic-watch-fgs.switch: Android requires it while the location service runs; it ends with the Traffic watch (stop watching) or the drive-alerts task
traffic-watch-fgs.note: Foreground-service notice: LOW, silent, one line saying why the service runs. Stays.

app-foreground-service.area: native: DreamScapeForegroundService.kt (placeholder and full notification) and its channel in MainActivity.createNotificationChannel
app-foreground-service.action: tap opens Dreamscape; Lock and Close buttons
app-foreground-service.switch: Android requires it while the app runs; the Close button ends it
app-foreground-service.note: Foreground-service notice: LOW, silent, ongoing, collapses. Stays.

miniport-state.area: native: MelatonMiniport.kt, the Miniport state on the foreground service notification only (Dreamscape as home screen); no notification of its own (#1321)
miniport-state.action: tap opens Dreamscape (added by wave C: it had none); Disconnect / Reconnect and Restart Devices buttons
miniport-state.switch: Android requires it while the app runs (merged into the foreground service); the Disconnect button
miniport-state.note: Required foreground service entry; silent, ongoing.

download-progress.area: native: MainActivity.kt, the Downloads channel and the Saving... progress notice
download-progress.action: none while running (progress); the finished notice opens the picture
download-progress.note: REMOVED by #1321 (DSApp fix/1321-no-android-notices): no emit site there. This entry stays only until that branch is on DSApp main, so other app branches pass the check.

download-saved.area: native: MainActivity.kt, the Saved notice with the picture after a Save
download-saved.note: REMOVED by #1321 (DSApp fix/1321-no-android-notices): no emit site there. This entry stays only until that branch is on DSApp main, so other app branches pass the check.

download-failed.area: native: MainActivity.kt, an Android toast 'Could not save <name>: <error>' only when the page that started the save cannot be reached (#1321); no notification
download-failed.action: none: the text is the information
download-failed.note: N1 a real failure of her own Save, told once (N10); silent.

download-folder.area: native: MainActivity.kt, Download folder not set
download-folder.action: tap brings the app to the front where the folder picker is open
download-folder.note: REMOVED by #1321 (DSApp fix/1321-no-android-notices): no emit site there. This entry stays only until that branch is on DSApp main, so other app branches pass the check.

app-notifications-bridge.area: native: MainActivity.kt NotificationBridge (window.AndroidNotification), a page toast mirrored as an Android notification in desktop (DeX) mode
app-notifications-bridge.action: tap opens the app (added by wave C: it had none); a toast's own buttons answer the page
app-notifications-bridge.switch: the app's Settings > In-app notifications; the page's notificationBridgeEnabled preference
app-notifications-bridge.note: REMOVED by #1321 (DSApp fix/1321-no-android-notices): no emit site there. This entry stays only until that branch is on DSApp main, so other app branches pass the check.

media-playback.area: native: MediaLibraryBridge.kt and videos/VideoPlayback.kt (#1322): the media notification of what Dreamscape plays (Melaton Media, XM Radio, Videos)
media-playback.action: tap opens the program that plays (XM Radio, Videos or Melaton Media); play / pause, and previous / next where there is a list
media-playback.switch: goes away when playback stops; Android's Melaton Media notification channel turns it off; the notice is the player's controls
media-playback.note: LOW, silent, one id updated in place: the controls of playback the user started (N1 exempt). While the app's player has Melaton Media's queue, Melaton Media's own is cleared (N6). After a pause it can stay up to 10 minutes (media3).

apk-install-waiting.area: native: activesync/ActiveSyncApkInstaller.kt, a program sent over ActiveSync waiting for Android's installer (or the unknown-apps permission)
apk-install-waiting.action: tap opens Android's installer prompt / the Install unknown apps page
apk-install-waiting.note: REMOVED by #1309 (DSApp fix/1309-no-installer); stays only until that branch is on DSApp main.

instant-hotspot-use.area: native: hotspot/InstantHotspot.kt, a computer is using this phone's mobile data
instant-hotspot-use.note: REMOVED by #1321 (DSApp fix/1321-no-android-notices): no emit site there. This entry stays only until that branch is on DSApp main, so other app branches pass the check.

widget-generation-fgs.area: native: widget/PresetWidget.kt GenerationService, a widget-started generation's progress
widget-generation-fgs.action: tap opens Dreamscape (added by wave C: it had none)
widget-generation-fgs.switch: ends when the generation ends; remove the widget
widget-generation-fgs.note: Foreground-service progress of a job the user started: LOW, silent, ongoing. N4 fixed by wave C.

widget-live-fgs.area: native: widget/WidgetLiveService.kt, keeps Latest frames and the workspace list live
widget-live-fgs.switch: Android requires it while the service runs; it stops when no widget follows the server live
widget-live-fgs.note: Foreground-service notice: MIN, silent, ongoing. Stays.
